en.name: Philosopher
en.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.

zh.name: 哲学家
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时，你可以选择一个善良角色：你获得该角色的能力。如果这个角色在场，他醉酒。
